title: Bedroom Layout Planner with Budget Conservation
description: An interactive bedroom interior design planner where users arrange SheenChairs within a modern bedroom scene under a fixed furniture budget. Users can place, move, rotate, and recolor chairs while a budget meter tracks total cost, enforcing conservation of the allocated design budget. Full undo/redo support lets users experiment freely.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements an interactive bedroom layout planner. Load minimalistic_modern_bedroom.glb as the static room environment centered at the origin. Load SheenChair.glb as a clonable furniture piece. Set up a perspective camera at position (5, 6, 8) looking at the room center with OrbitControls for navigation. Add ambient light intensity 0.6 and a directional light from (3, 8, 5) with intensity 1.0 and soft shadows enabled on a shadow-mapped renderer. Implement these interactions requiring 10-14 steps total: (1) A toolbar panel on the left with buttons for Add Chair (costs $150 from a $900 total budget), Delete Selected ($150 refund), Rotate CW 45deg, Rotate CCW 45deg, and a color picker that applies tint to the selected chair material at $25 per recolor. (2) Clicking Add Chair clones the SheenChair model and places it at a default position with a green placement indicator. Users drag chairs on the floor plane using raycasting against an invisible ground plane at y=0. (3) Budget conservation law: total spending must never exceed $900. Display a budget bar at the top showing remaining funds. Adding a chair deducts $150, deleting refunds $150, recoloring deducts $25. Gray out buttons when budget is insufficient. (4) Multi-input coupling: holding Shift while dragging snaps chairs to a 0.5-unit grid. Holding Ctrl while clicking two chairs swaps their positions simultaneously. (5) Full undo/redo stack using Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y that records every action including placements, deletions, moves, rotations, and recolors, properly restoring budget on undo. Highlight the selected chair with a yellow emissive outline. Show a step counter and budget display as an HTML overlay. Ensure all chair instances cast and receive shadows within the bedroom scene.
